name: Missouri
agencyName: Missouri Department of Revenue (Motor Vehicle and Driver Licensing)

retake.retakeFee: No fee for written or non-CDL skills testing; permit/license fee is paid separately after passing

gdl.supervisedHoursRequired: 40 hours (10 at night), certified by parent/guardian
gdl.nightCurfew: Intermediate: no driving 1 a.m.-5 a.m. (with exceptions)
gdl.passengerLimits: Intermediate first 6 months: no more than 1 passenger under 19; thereafter no more than 3 passengers under 19

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity (e.g. certified birth certificate or U.S. passport)
Proof of lawful status (if not a U.S. citizen)
process.realIdNotes: Missouri offers an optional REAL ID-compliant license/permit marked with a star. A REAL ID or passport is required to board domestic flights and enter certain federal facilities.
process.permitFee: $3.50 (instruction permit; confirm current DOR fee chart)
process.licenseFee: $14.00 (intermediate license); Class F full license fees vary by term
process.visionStandard: 20/40 in at least one eye, with or without corrective lenses

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: 8 points in 18 months results in suspension; 12 in 12 months, 18 in 24 months, or 24 in 36 months results in revocation
facts.moveOverRule: Move over a lane or slow down for stopped emergency and Department of Transportation vehicles displaying flashing lights
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: Reduced limit as posted during school hours

references.label: Missouri Driver Guide
references.citation: Missouri Driver Guide (Missouri Department of Revenue)
